SELECT a.user_code AS usercode, a.user_name, a.`name`, c.age, c.bmi AS bmi, d.fr_frequency AS frequency, f.Flag_Dgroup, e.record_data FROM `yh_user_reginfo` AS a LEFT JOIN `yh_user_make_card` AS b ON a.user_code = b.user_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tr1.user_code, tr1.age, tr1.bmi FROM yh_disease_assess_total_report2 AS tr1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT max(id) AS id FROM yh_disease_assess_total_report2 GROUP BY user_code ) AS tr2 ON tr1.id = tr2.id ) AS c ON a.user_code = c.user_code LEFT JOIN `yh_sport_frequency` AS d ON a.user_code = d.user_code LEFT JOIN `yh_user_enrolinfo` AS f ON a.user_code = f.user_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rr1.user_code, rr1.record_data FROM yh_sport_recommend_record AS rr1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT max(id) AS id FROM yh_sport_recommend_record GROUP BY user_code ) AS rr2 ON rr1.id = rr2.id ) AS e ON e.user_code = a.user_code
b.doctor=(SELECT id FROM `yh_user_admin_info` WHERE user_code=#{usercode})
and b.Org_Id=#{orgid}
and f.Flag_Dgroup LIKE CONCAT('%',#{groupid},'%')
and e.record_mode=#{mode} and e.record_type=1
and c.bmi < 18.5
and c.bmi >=18.5 and c.bmi <=23.9
and c.bmi >=24 and c.bmi <=27.9
and c.bmi >28
and c.age >= #{ageStr}
and c.age <= #{ageEnd}
and e.sport_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{recordname},'%') and e.record_type=1
and a.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{username},'%')
GROUP BY a.user_code
